categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing CIGU Technology Corp., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of magnetic levitation fluid machinery and core components such as magnetic levitation bearings, high-speed motors, and drives. Its main products include magnetic levitation centrifugal blowers, magnetic levitation air compressors, magnetic levitation chillers, magnetic levitation vacuum pumps, and magnetic levitation expansion power generation units. These products serve industries like wastewater treatment, chemical, textile, printing and dyeing, food, pharmaceuticals, and paper manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include five-degree-of-freedom magnetic levitation bearings, high-power high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motors, dedicated high-speed motor frequency converters, high-speed efficient centrifugal impellers and flow components, and integrated systems based on magnetic levitation bearings. Production involves advanced electromagnetic control algorithms, high-frequency vector control, and fluid dynamics design based on three-dimensional flow theory. Manufacturing includes assembly of main units, electrical control, and cabinets, with some non-core processes outsourced to qualified third parties.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial enterprises in sectors such as municipal wastewater treatment, chemical processing, textiles, printing and dyeing, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, paper, electronics, and energy. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with growing sales in Southeast Asia and other emerging regions. Major customers include large state-owned and private enterprises in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded overseas sales, particularly in Southeast Asia, achieving significant growth in export revenue. Its products are used nationwide across all provinces and cities in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing CIGU Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of advanced magnetic levitation fluid machinery and core components. It procures raw materials and components such as electronic parts, impellers, cabinets, and frequency converters from upstream suppliers and sells finished products directly or through distributors to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation and high R&D investment, focusing on new product development and technology pre-research. Key R&D projects include expanding the product range of magnetic levitation air compressors, vacuum pumps, chillers, and power generation units, improving product efficiency, stability, and cost reduction. It also invests in core technology upgrades such as sensor improvements, control algorithm iterations, and high-voltage magnetic levitation motor development. The company maintains strong collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of magnetic levitation fluid machinery products and related components. The company employs a sales model combining direct sales and authorized distributors, with pricing based on production costs, market demand, and customer order specifics. It also earns income from contract energy management services based on shared energy savings with clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic brand in magnetic levitation fluid machinery with advanced core technologies and a comprehensive product portfolio. It competes with international firms like SKF, Waukesha, IBAG, Sulzer, and Atlas Copco in magnetic levitation bearing and blower markets. While foreign brands have a longer history, Nanjing CIGU has achieved significant technological breakthroughs and market penetration in China, gradually replacing imports and expanding its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 478.5 million, a 15.7% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 51.5 million, up 7.16%. R&D expenses accounted for 9.17% of revenue. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.43 billion with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. It maintains a stable profitability trajectory with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing CIGU Technology offers high-efficiency, energy-saving magnetic levitation fluid machinery characterized by non-contact transmission, high speed, low noise, and minimal maintenance. Its products provide significant energy savings compared to traditional equipment (e.g., 25-30% for blowers, 20% for air compressors, 30-50% for chillers). The company’s proprietary core technologies and integrated control systems enable superior performance, reliability, and remote monitoring capabilities, delivering enhanced value to customers in energy-intensive industries.
